ꜥm: ꜥm — to swallow, eat (?) (verb 2-lit.; the spelling here is with the crossed planks im, so the reading and the sense are not sure; Budge: àmu 'eat')
ꜣgy: ꜣgy — Agy, name of a place in the other world, which Budge calls the Lake of Flowers (place name; written with the lake sign and the numeral 3; the meaning of the name is not clear to me (?); Budge: Aḳi)
ḫwḫt: ḫwḫt — a kind of boat (?) (noun f.; written with a boat as classifier; a rare word, sense guessed from the classifier; Budge: χuχet 'a boat')
ḫwdt: ḫwdt — a kind of boat (?) (noun f.; written with a boat as classifier; perhaps the same word as ḫwḫt in another spelling; sense uncertain; Budge: χuṭet 'the boat')
šdn: šdn — to bind, cover over, blind (?) (verb; stative šdntt, said of eyes; the cord classifier points to binding; sense uncertain; Budge: śeṭentet 'blinded')
dwn: dwn — to stretch out, straighten; to raise up, rise (verb 3-lit.; Budge: ṭunu 'stretch out', 'rise')
qrf: qrf — to be drawn together, contracted, bound up (?) (verb; stative qrfy; the cord classifier points to binding; sense uncertain; Budge: qerfi 'fastened together')
srwd: srwd — to make firm, strengthen (verb 4-lit., causative of rwd 'be firm, hard')
mꜣst: mꜣst — knee, thigh (?) (noun f.; dual mꜣsty 'the two knees'; Budge: masti 'legs')
ḫni: ḫni — to shut in, hold back, restrain (?) (verb; the signs give ḫni, probably a writing of ḫnr 'restrain, imprison'; sense uncertain; Budge: χenà 'be imprisoned')
tm: tm — to be complete, whole; as an auxiliary, 'not to do' (verb 2-lit.; tm + infinitive negates it, as in rꜣ n tm rdit … 'spell of not letting …'; Budge: tem)
sḫnš: sḫnš — to make foul, make stink, defame (?) (verb 4-lit., causative of ḫnš 'stink'; sense taken from the causative; Budge: seχenś 'make to stink')

__broaden__.ꜥꜣ: ꜥꜣ — great (adjective); (adverb) here, hither · a second word of the same spelling: donkey, ass (noun) · a third word of the same spelling: door, door-leaf (noun; iry-ꜥꜣ "doorkeeper") · also greatly, very (adverb, after an adjective or participle: ḥsy ꜥꜣ 'greatly favoured') · dual ꜥꜣwy 'the two doors, the double door' (noun; written with the door-leaf twice)
__broaden__.ḥn: ḥn — to hasten (?) (verb; reading and sense uncertain) · also with a plural subject, ḥn·n 'we hasten (?)'
